sentences.text: He further submits that petitioner has not filed any representation for compensation of his land.
As such, petitioner may be directed to file a representation before the competent authority under the law.
5. In this background, petitioner is directed to file his representation before the Land Acquisition Officer, Muzaffarpur to provide the copy of award and award money to him.

6. Petitioner shall be at liberty to accept the said award amount with objection and he shall also be at liberty to take appropriate legal steps if not satisfied of the award amount under Section 3 G(5) of the National Highway Act, 1956.
7. With the aforesaid direction, this writ petition is hereby disposed off.
